body:
First raised: 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles), during the subject-by-subject review in #405.

## Finding and scope

Henderson Island is a named physical island nested in the four-island Pitcairn group. UNESCO supports that parent/group meaning, but the retained Natural Earth Admin1 feature is the broader four-island group rather than a dedicated Henderson coastline. The current Henderson footprint therefore lacks a matching source-tier confirmation; this is unresolved source suitability, not a proven geometric correction.

Subject: `PCN+00?` only.

The exact retained comparator and hierarchy crosswalk are in #405 and PR #1054. The scoped Natural Earth source extract SHA-256 is `dd3f4a5683c713fd89c00b41748d89771f905ef236feaacb7887818085f3d96e`; full-source restoration details and public-domain terms are pinned in that packet.

## Acceptance

- Confirm current official physical/administrative meaning of Henderson and the neighboring Oeno, Ducie and Pitcairn islands; maintain the four-island parent relationship.
- Find and assess a lawful island-level outline source or explain why none supports an exact current Henderson coastline; distinguish heritage descriptions from boundary data.
- Record source vintage, license, exact hashes/restoration steps, retrieval date, baseline pins, reproducible geometry checks/controls and uncertainty.
- Preserve the current ID, parent, history and release pins. Geography evidence and engineering handoff only; do not edit shared geography or production data.
- Link bounded sourced action if an actual correction is supported and obtain independent exact-head review.

No regional approval or historical import is included.

## Dependency and ownership

This issue depends on completion of #405. Begin only after its exact source evidence is available on main. Own only `data/regional-review/henderson-island-boundary-20261005/`.
